name: Medprompt Framework
executive_summary: SOTA medical QA ensemble combining kNN exemplar selection, chain-of-thought reasoning, and choice-shuffling ensembling. Achieves ~90% on MedQA, surpassing many fine-tuned medical models.
description: Medprompt is a composition of three techniques optimized for medical question answering: (1) dynamic kNN exemplar selection from a medical training set to retrieve similar cases, (2) chain-of-thought prompting with medical reasoning steps, and (3) choice-shuffling ensembling, which re-runs the question with the answer options permuted and votes across the runs. The framework demonstrates that careful prompt engineering can match or exceed domain-specific fine-tuning.
when_to_use: Medical question answering where accuracy is critical.
When you have access to a medical exemplar dataset for kNN retrieval.
when_not_to_use: Non-medical domains (the kNN exemplars are medical-specific).
When no medical exemplar dataset is available.
Real-time applications where the multi-call ensemble is too slow.
known_pitfalls: kNN retrieval quality depends on the exemplar dataset coverage.
Medical reasoning chains can still hallucinate rare conditions.
Self-consistency may converge on common but incorrect answers.

primary_source.authors: Nori, Lee, Zhang, Carignan, Edgar, Fusi, King, Larson, Li, Liu, et al.
primary_source.title: Can Generalist Foundation Models Outcompete Special-Purpose Tuning? Case Study in Medicine

variables.name: medical_question
variables.example: A 55-year-old male presents with chest pain radiating to the left arm. What is the most likely diagnosis?

variables.name: k
variables.description: Number of kNN exemplars to retrieve.

variables.name: exemplars
variables.example: [Case 1: 60M chest pain → MI], [Case 2: 50M chest pain → unstable angina]

variables.name: n
variables.description: Number of reasoning paths for self-consistency.

variables.name: consensus_answer
variables.description: The final answer after majority voting.

usage_templates.reproducibility_note: kNN retrieval is deterministic given fixed embeddings. CoT generation requires temperature > 0 for path diversity. Self-consistency voting is deterministic.
